fullTextEN: Hello,
Hello everyone,
I am Xiaoxiao,
I am from Henan, China,

fullTextZH: 之前我在上海上学了一段时间，
fullTextEN: Previously, I studied in Shanghai for a while,
Studying means going to school,

fullTextZH: 现在我回到了我的家乡河南工作工作。
fullTextEN: Now I have returned to my hometown in Henan to work.

fullTextZH: 上海是中国最繁华最热闹最有钱的城市，
fullTextEN: Shanghai is the most prosperous, lively, and wealthy city in China,

fullTextZH: 而我的家乡只是河南的一个小小的村子，
fullTextEN: while my hometown is just a small village in Henan,
It is not as lively as Shanghai,
not as prosperous as Shanghai,
and even less wealthy than Shanghai,

fullTextZH: 所以生活在上海和生活在河南有很大的区别，
fullTextEN: so living in Shanghai and living in Henan are very different,

fullTextZH: 那么具体是哪些区别呢？
fullTextEN: So what are the specific differences?
First, in terms of food,

fullTextZH: 上海是一个非常国际化的城市，
fullTextEN: Shanghai is a very international city,

fullTextZH: 它有全世界各地的美食。
fullTextEN: It has cuisine from all over the world.
If you live in Shanghai,

fullTextZH: 但是你想吃其他地方的食物，
fullTextEN: but you want to eat food from other places,

fullTextZH: 比如西班牙、俄罗斯或者日本等等，
fullTextEN: such as Spain, Russia, or Japan, etc.,

fullTextZH: 那么你出门在上海的商场或者是街边都很容易发现这些食物的影子。
fullTextEN: So when you go out in Shanghai, it's very easy to find traces of these foods in malls or on the streets.
If you don't feel like going out,
Hmm,
don't want to go out,
or if the weather is bad,
for example, if it's raining or snowing,

fullTextZH: 你也可以在手机上点外卖，
fullTextEN: you can also order takeout on your phone,

fullTextZH: 外卖员会把你点的食物送到家门口，
fullTextEN: The delivery person will bring the food you ordered to your doorstep,

fullTextZH: 这样你也可以很方便地吃到自己想要的食物。
fullTextEN: so you can conveniently eat the food you want.

fullTextZH: 但是如果你生活在我的家乡，
fullTextEN: But if you live in my hometown,
which is Henan,

fullTextZH: 一般你只能吃到本地的食物。
fullTextEN: you can generally only eat local food.
If I cook for myself,

fullTextZH: 早上一般是包子或者油条，
fullTextEN: in the morning, it's usually buns or fried dough sticks,

fullTextZH: 然后我自己会煮一些粥喝，
fullTextEN: then I will cook some porridge to drink,

fullTextZH: 比如说小米粥或者大米粥。
fullTextEN: such as millet porridge or rice porridge.
As for lunch,
our family usually makes pasta,
which is noodles,
all are very delicious foods.
Dinner is very simple,

fullTextZH: 一般就是煮粥或者加几个炒菜。
fullTextEN: It's usually just porridge or a few stir-fried dishes.
As our old saying goes,
In the morning, eat well,
At noon, eat until full,
In the evening, eat less.

fullTextZH: 中国人认为这种吃饭方式是健康的。
fullTextEN: Chinese people believe this way of eating is healthy.
Speaking of breakfast in Henan,
You might have heard of spicy soup.

fullTextZH: 胡辣汤是河南非常有特色的当地小吃，
fullTextEN: Spicy soup is a very distinctive local snack in Henan,

fullTextZH: 它里面有海带、花生米、豆皮等等食材，
fullTextEN: It contains ingredients like kelp, peanuts, tofu skin, etc.

fullTextZH: 如果你来到河南早上喝胡辣汤的话，
fullTextEN: If you come to Henan and drink spicy soup in the morning,

fullTextZH: 记得要配上油条一起吃哦。
fullTextEN: Remember to pair it with fried dough sticks.
So,
If you live in Henan,

fullTextZH: 你吃到的大部分食物都是河南本地的，
fullTextEN: Most of the food you eat is local to Henan,

fullTextZH: 不太能吃到世界各地的美食。
fullTextEN: You can't really eat food from all over the world.

fullTextZH: 那如果我要买蔬菜或者买水果怎么办呢？
fullTextEN: So what if I want to buy vegetables or fruits?

fullTextZH: 当我生活在上海的时候，
fullTextEN: When I lived in Shanghai,
I usually walked into a supermarket,

fullTextZH: 然后把水果或者蔬菜放到篮子里，
fullTextEN: Then put the fruits or vegetables into the basket,
Then go to the counter to pay,
Pay them the money,

fullTextZH: 我就可以拿着食物走掉了。
fullTextEN: Then I can take the food and leave.
Doing this is very convenient,
But it's also very expensive,

fullTextZH: 但是如果我生活在河南，
fullTextEN: But if I live in Henan,
If I want to eat something,
I can grow it myself,
This is my family's vegetable garden,

fullTextZH: 你们能看到上面的生菜长得非常非常好，
fullTextEN: You can see the lettuce growing very well on it,

fullTextZH: 我想吃什么就可以直接种什么，
fullTextEN: I can grow whatever I want to eat directly,
Not only is it very cheap,
But also very fresh.

fullTextZH: 今年我姥姥家的枣树结了超级大的果子，
fullTextEN: This year, my grandma's jujube tree bore super large fruits,
If I want to eat jujubes,

fullTextZH: 我就走到我姥姥的家门口，
fullTextEN: I just walk to my grandma's doorstep,
Directly pick the jujubes,
This way, not only is it very fresh,
But also very delicious,
Do you know?

fullTextZH: 河南有非常非常多的农民，
fullTextEN: Henan has a lot of farmers,

fullTextZH: 我的爷爷奶奶也是农民，
fullTextEN: My grandparents are also farmers,

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得我非常会种地。
fullTextEN: So I think I am very good at farming.

fullTextZH: 那么今天的介绍就讲到这里了，
fullTextEN: So today's introduction ends here,

fullTextZH: 你觉得在上海生活还是在河南生活会更有趣一点呢？
fullTextEN: Do you think living in Shanghai or Henan would be more interesting?
Please leave a comment and tell me.
